topic: Forms of Energy and Heat Transfer
key_concepts: Energy is the ability to do work
Kinetic energy is possessed by moving objects
Potential energy is stored in objects at rest
Sound energy is produced by vibrating objects
Nuclear energy comes from the nucleus of an atom
Static electricity is energy of charges at rest
Electric current is the net flow of electrons
The Law of Conservation of Energy states energy cannot be created or destroyed, only trans
Heat transfers from hot to cold objects
Heat transfer occurs through conduction, convection, and radiation
The sun is the main source of energy for the planet
Geothermal energy comes from heat inside the Earth
